verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator installed via npm that runs coding-agent loops, isolated task worktrees, and parallel fan-out on the user's own machine and Git checkout. That covers the local self-hosting part of the story. Nothing in the evidence covers container images, VM deployment, or remote and shared infrastructure. Missing for 10: documented container deployment, deployment on self-managed VMs or servers, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.
